question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Recluse
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Recluse"** refers to a person who lives a solitary life and tends to avoid other people. (एकांतप्रिय व्यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example:** The old man was a recluse, living alone in a cabin deep in the woods.
 
 
 
• **"Solitary"** means being alone, without others, or existing by itself. (एकाकी)
 
 
• **Example:** She enjoyed solitary walks along the beach to clear her mind.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **"Recluse"** is **"Solitary"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Closeness** (निकटता): The quality of being near to something or someone.

 
 
• **Example:** The closeness of the siblings was evident in their constant support for each other.
 
 
 
• **Sociable** (मिलनसार): Someone who enjoys being in the company of others; friendly and outgoing.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very sociable and loves attending parties and gatherings.
 
 
 
• **Candid** (स्पष्टवादी): Being open, honest, and straightforward in speech or expression.
 
 
• **Example:** He gave a candid account of what really happened during the meeting.
